long_biography.plain_text:
Sherborne House became a major restoration project for pub entrepreneur Michael Cannon and his wife, Sally. They bought the neglected Dorset mansion in 2018 and established a trust to restore it as a cultural centre. Cannon took a close interest in the work, from structural repairs to the choice of historic fittings.

His contribution extended to individual rooms: he chose purple-and-gold chinoiserie wallpaper and supplied a Georgian fireplace from his own collection. Cannon died before the completed house reopened in 2024. Sally continued the project, and the restored building welcomed the public as an arts centre with free admission.

They bought the neglected Dorset mansion in 2018 and established a trust to restore it as a cultural centre. His contribution extended to individual rooms: he chose purple-and-gold chinoiserie wallpaper and supplied a Georgian fireplace from his own collection. Cannon died before the completed house reopened in 2024. Sally continued the project, and the restored building welcomed the public as an arts centre with free admission.
